title: Odds & Ends
blurb: Tear open trading-card packs of household things, from a two-cent paper clip to a $1,500 grand piano. Swipe the top off, pull the cards out and flip through them. Holos shimmer when you tilt them. Sell what you don't want for more packs, keep the rest in a binder that never runs out of pages, and work up to booster boxes. Find 50 of them and the Backyard expansion unlocks: fifty toys, critters and bugs from out back. Find most of those and Outer Space opens up: rockets, space suits, planets, stars and a black hole. Share a lucky pull with a link: friends can look, but it stays yours. New players get an anime-style intro and a quick walkthrough of their first pack.
